tools.name: spurvik_scan_live_url
tools.description: Scan one public HTTPS page for AI chat widgets and AI SDKs and check whether a visible EU AI Act Article 50(1) notice is present. Returns the host, HTTP status, findings, the suggested notice language, a one-line badge.js fix and links to the full report. Heuristic: reads the HTML of one page only.

tools.name: spurvik_classify_ai_act_risk
tools.description: Self-assessment of an AI system under the EU AI Act from a few answers: prohibited (Article 5), high-risk (Annex III), Article 50 transparency only, minimal risk, or outside the EU. Returns the duties with their dates and the Spurvik setup steps. Not legal advice and not a decision under Article 6.

tools.name: spurvik_generate_art50_badge
tools.description: Generate a copy-paste EU AI Act Article 50 notice: a badge.js <script> tag or a React <AIDisclosureLabel /> snippet, in any of the 24 EU languages, with a preview of the notice text. The language is inferred from a domain-like systemName when locale is omitted.
